opaque_tokens.algorithm: SHA256(TOKEN_SALT + NUL + prompt_sha256 + NUL + canonical_source_sha256) truncated to 16 uppercase hexadecimal characters

nc_legacy_two_member_checkpoint.interpretation_boundary: The additional N candidate is an outcome-blind navigation/coverage comparator, not a newly asserted third local route or a claim that the legacy cluster passed the source-native all-three-family gate.
nc_legacy_two_member_checkpoint.required_sensitivity_reporting: Report this stratum separately and preserve a sensitivity analysis excluding it from the source-native three-member NC population.

selection_invariants: Force only the frozen canonical local roster, then select external candidates from the frozen canonical union minus that roster.
Within each channel use the prospectively frozen score descending then canonical source SHA-256 ascending order.
Skip every already-selected SHA globally; no SHA may fill more than one main-pool slot.
When no positive unused candidate remains in a required channel, continue its complete eligible ranking in the same order and tag the chosen row as a zero-score coverage fallback.
Fail closed for any prompt lacking six distinct eligible main-pool candidates; never shorten the pool, alter K, use a label, or substitute a manual choice.

tail_per_prompt_group.phrase: highest positive H-ranked candidate outside main pool
tail_per_prompt_group.residual: first unrepresented reporting role in frozen order, then minimum SHA256(prompt_sha256:candidate_sha256)
